summary: Velo3D filed an 8-K reporting a firm commitment underwritten registered direct offering of 3,571,428 shares at $14.00/share, expected gross proceeds of $50 million, closing April 28, 2026. Cantor Fitzgerald is sole underwriter, receiving a 6.0% discount. Shares are sold under an effective shelf registration statement. Lock-up of 60 days applies to directors, officers, and certain stockholders. This is a capital raise, not a tender offer; categorized as Issuer Tenders only per the schema's label for an issuer sale. Watch for market reception and potential dilution.
